$comment: Schema for REQ-METIS-CONN-01/02 (metis-connector-architecture.md). A new intake source is added by writing a manifest conforming to this schema, not by modifying pipeline code. trust_tier_on_first_use is hardcoded to calibration_required in this schema -- no manifest can opt out of the Data Quality Framework's CONST-036 onboarding gate.

athena_internal_read_config.description: Required if protocol=athena_internal_read. Reads FROM Athena's already-populated tables/views for sources Athena already ingests (git, jira, openapi, pipeline, kube, tms/scale) -- does NOT re-fetch from the original external source. This is the corrected ETL pattern: the graph is derived from Athena's existing data, not a second independent ingestion of the same sources.

athena_schema_object.description: the logical Athena schema-catalog object to read, e.g. 'athena.mv_commits', resolved via Athena's existing schema-catalog pattern (athena_schema_catalog.py), not a hardcoded table name

change_detection_column.description: the column used for incremental sync (e.g. 'updated_at') -- polling this, not re-calling the original external API, is what makes this protocol cheap and avoids the duplicate-ingestion problem

server_provider.description: e.g. 'Grafana Labs official', 'Atlassian Rovo official', 'mcp-atlassian (community, Server/Data Center)'

tool_allowlist.description: Explicit subset of the external MCP server's tools this connector is permitted to call -- least-privilege, not 'all tools the server happens to expose'.

source_shape.description: what the source data looks like, e.g. 'Grafana alert rule', 'Jira issue of type Bug'

target_entity_type.description: the ontology entity this becomes, e.g. 'Alert', 'Defect'

t_recorded_source.description: which field on the source system is used as t_recorded, per §5.1's rule that t_recorded is preferred over re-derivation

environment_scope.description: BS-010: enforced at credential level, not just this manifest field -- the field documents intent, the credential enforces it.

trust_tier_on_first_use.description: Hardcoded -- no manifest may set anything else. Every new connector goes through the 500-extraction calibration batch (Data Quality Framework §3.2, CONST-036) before reaching auto_write confidence tier.
